messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** | 2006 | Former Vice President Al Gore presents a compelling case for the urgent need to address climate change, using data, personal anecdotes, and a global perspective. |
| **An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power** | 2017 | Al Gore continues his advocacy, focusing on policy solutions, the role of corporations, and the importance of individual action. |
| **Before the Flood** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels around the world to witness the impacts of climate change, meeting scientists, activists, and policymakers. |
| **Climate Change: The Facts** | 2019 | A BBC production that examines the science behind climate change, its impacts, and potential mitigation strategies. |
| **The 11th Hour** | 2007 | Produced by Leonardo DiCaprio, this film explores the environmental crisis and offers a vision for a sustainable future. |
| **Our Planet** (Series) | 2019 | While not solely about climate change, this nature series highlights how global warming threatens ecosystems worldwide. |
| **The End of the Line** | 2009 | Focuses on the overfishing crisis and its connection to climate change, illustrating the broader impacts on marine life. |

These documentaries are widely available on streaming platforms such as Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, or through DVD/Blu‑ray. They provide a mix of scientific evidence, personal stories, and calls to action that can help deepen your understanding of global warming.
